name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, battle core table data_fd2_battle_, descriptor reflects role (per-glyph horizontal x pixel offset) and data type (queue/array). No Ghidra address residue. The 'x_offset' descriptor is the canonical correct role: although fd2_show_miss_indicator's local var is misleadingly named 'y_offset', the value lands in this same queue and the consumer fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths adds it as a raw horizontal pixel offset (ADD into framebuffer dst within the scanline), confirming it is an x-offset.
purpose: Runtime scratch queue holding the per-glyph horizontal x pixel offset for the floating damage-number / MISS overlay enqueued above a target's head during a battle spell/attack.
logic_summary: Second of three contiguous, equal-length (200-byte) parallel queues sharing the running index data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx: sprite_id @0x53C6C, x_offset @0x53D34, target_char_idx @0x53DFC. Producers append 4 entries per call (idx advanced +4 each call): fd2_show_damage_number stores digit_iter*5+2 (5px/digit horizontal layout); fd2_show_miss_indicator stores 8 for the middle glyph (char_iter==1) else char_iter*5+2. Consumer fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths walks slots 0..count-1, MOVZX-loads each slot, and ADDs it as a raw horizontal pixel offset into the framebuffer destination pointer when blitting the glyph sprite.
element_semantics: Per-slot (per-glyph) horizontal pixel x-offset (zero-extended byte) added directly to the framebuffer destination pointer within the current scanline when blitting the floating overlay glyph. uint8 element, stride 1 (8-bit MOV stores in both producers; MOVZX zero-extending byte load in the consumer). 200-byte extent fixed by the 0xC8 gap to the next queue at 0x53DFC.
notes: BSS (.object2/.bss) runtime queue: memory reads all-zero (200 bytes), every slot written before read, so static contents are don't-care; not const (two game writers fd2_show_damage_number @0x1e193 DATA-write and fd2_show_miss_indicator @0x1e27a DATA-write; one reader fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths @0x1e060 READ). src comment block (btltab2.c lines 275-302) already precise and accurate (role, extent derivation, BSS don't-care, both producer formulas, consumer raw-pixel-offset use, uint8 justification via MOVZX) -> comment_verdict=keep, no src edit. Ghidra data plate was null/empty -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (data plates cannot use MCP set_plate_comment), src conclusions as source of truth, including the 'y_offset' misnomer note. No logic/type/signature changes made.
